cad.load: Compression through inclined bearing

notes: The substrate still needs designed drainage falls; a slope corrector levels the finish support, not the membrane plane.

objects.name: terrace pedestal levelling shim
objects.definition: A thin product-compatible full or quadrant pad used on a pedestal head or base for fine level adjustment, paver calibration or rocking correction.
functions: Reduce rocking at one support quadrant

cad.pattern: Discrete thin shim at selected bearing quadrant
cad.placement: On pedestal head or beneath base
cad.opening: Does not obstruct spacer or drain paths
cad.load: Local compression

objects.name: terrace pedestal paver spacer tabs
objects.definition: Removable or integral vertical fins on a pedestal head that separate adjacent paver corners and establish a consistent open joint.
functions: Allow water to pass between pavers

cad.pattern: Two, three or four fins at paver intersection
cad.placement: On pedestal head between paver edges
cad.opening: Open joint remains between tabs
cad.load: Lateral location only, not main bearing

objects.name: terrace pedestal height extender
objects.definition: A product-specific intermediate collar or segment inserted between pedestal base, body and head to increase the support height within stated combinations and stability limits.

cad.pattern: One or more locked segments within selected pedestal
cad.placement: Between base/body and head
cad.opening: Bracing tabs remain accessible where provided
cad.load: Axial compression through modular joints

objects.name: terrace pedestal locking collar
objects.definition: A threaded, snap or clamp ring locking an adjustable pedestal at its set height and improving stability according to the selected product system.

cad.pattern: One collar at adjustable junction
cad.placement: Around threaded or telescopic body
cad.opening: Adjustment access remains as designed
cad.load: Locking and stability only

objects.name: pedestal decking-bearer holder
objects.definition: A bracket fixed to a pedestal head that cradles and laterally locates a timber, aluminium or steel bearer or rail supporting raised decking or deck tiles.
functions: Locate a bearer on the pedestal
Transfer bearer reaction to the head
Provide fixing points for the bearer

cad.pattern: One holder at each bearer-to-pedestal intersection
cad.placement: On pedestal head
cad.opening: Drainage around holder remains open
cad.load: Bearer compression and lateral location to pedestal

objects.name: pedestal-supported decking rail
objects.definition: A timber, aluminium or steel rail spanning between pedestals and supporting deck boards, deck tiles or paver trays above the drainage cavity.

cad.pattern: Parallel rails over pedestal rows
cad.placement: Within raised finish cavity
cad.opening: Drains and services pass between rails
cad.load: Finish loads to pedestals

objects.name: pedestal-head acoustic and anti-slip pad
objects.definition: A thin resilient facing on or above a pedestal head that reduces impact noise, slipping, abrasion or rocking between the support and paver or rail.

cad.pattern: One pad on each pedestal head or quadrant
cad.placement: Between head and finish unit
cad.opening: Spacer and drainage openings remain clear
cad.load: Local compression and friction

objects.name: raised-paver perimeter retainer
objects.definition: A clip, angle, wall spacer, curb or proprietary edge fitting restraining the outer paver or panel row against lateral movement while maintaining the required wall gap and drainage.
functions: Finish or conceal the exposed pedestal edge
not_synonyms: tile edge trim for bonded tiles

cad.pattern: Continuous or discrete restraint along raised finish edge
cad.placement: At wall, parapet or free perimeter
cad.opening: Perimeter drainage gap remains open
cad.load: Lateral finish restraint to support or edge

objects.name: pedestal-paver uplift retainer
objects.definition: A proprietary concealed or exposed clip, plate, adhesive connection or mechanical assembly tying raised pavers to pedestals or rails where wind uplift or other dislodgement risk requires restraint.
functions: Tie finish unit to support grid
Maintain removable or serviceable behaviour where designed

cad.pattern: Discrete at paver corners, edges or designed grid
cad.placement: Between paver and pedestal or rail
cad.opening: Drainage joints remain open
cad.load: Wind uplift and dislodgement actions to support system

notes: Gravity seating alone must not be assumed adequate in exposed wind zones.

objects.name: exterior pedestal-supported paver
objects.definition: A self-supporting exterior paving unit designed to span between discrete pedestal bearings, with material, dimensions, breaking-load evidence, surface traction, edge condition and support points documented.
functions: Provide one module of the raised traffic surface
Allow water through open joints to the drainage plane

cad.pattern: Repeated modular panels with corner and supplementary supports
cad.placement: On pedestal heads
cad.opening: Open joints surround each module
cad.load: Paver plate action to pedestal points

notes: A tile suitable for bonded installation is not automatically thick or strong enough to bridge pedestals.

objects.name: porcelain pedestal paver
objects.definition: A thick exterior porcelain paving unit with documented pedestal support, breaking-load and slip performance, used dry-laid above a drainage plane rather than bonded as a thin tile.
functions: Provide a hard low-absorption raised finish

cad.pattern: Repeated porcelain modules
cad.placement: On pedestal grid
cad.opening: Open joints around module
cad.load: Panel bending to pedestal heads

objects.name: concrete pedestal paver
objects.definition: A precast concrete paving slab with dimensions, reinforcement if any, breaking load and edge condition suitable for dry support on a documented pedestal grid.
functions: Provide a robust raised traffic finish
Allow drainage below and removable access

cad.pattern: Repeated precast concrete panels
cad.placement: On pedestal heads
cad.opening: Open joints around paver
cad.load: Paver plate action to pedestals

objects.name: natural-stone pedestal paver
objects.definition: A selected natural-stone slab used as a raised paver only with documented stone type, thickness, flaws, support pattern, breaking strength, slip surface and edge restraint.
functions: Allow dry access to the cavity
materials: granite, sandstone, bluestone or other tested natural stone

cad.pattern: Repeated stone panels
cad.placement: On compatible pedestal bearings
cad.opening: Open joints around slab
cad.load: Stone plate action to pedestal points

notes: Natural variability and hidden flaws make product-specific breaking evidence important.

objects.name: exterior modular deck tile
objects.definition: A factory-made or prefabricated trafficable panel of timber, composite, aluminium or other exterior decking fixed to an integral backing or mini-frame and laid on pedestals, rails or a drained hard surface.
functions: Provide a removable deck-look finish module
Allow drainage through panel joints and slats

cad.pattern: Repeated removable square or rectangular panels
cad.placement: On pedestal heads, rails or compatible hard substrate
cad.opening: Slat and module joints drain to cavity
cad.load: Panel to pedestals or rails

objects.name: timber deck tile
objects.definition: A modular exterior panel of solid timber slats fixed to battens or backing, with species, durability or treatment, connectors, finish and support system documented.

cad.pattern: Repeated timber slat modules
cad.placement: On raised support system
cad.opening: Slat gaps and panel joints remain open
cad.load: Slats to backing and backing to supports

objects.name: composite deck tile
objects.definition: A modular exterior panel of wood-plastic composite or other manufactured decking slats fixed or moulded to a backing grid and supported over a drainage plane.

cad.pattern: Repeated manufactured panels
cad.placement: On pedestal, rail or compatible hard substrate
cad.opening: Open module and slat joints
cad.load: Panel backing to supports

objects.name: removable drain-access paver
objects.definition: A normal or specially framed raised paver identified and detailed for lifting above a concealed outlet, channel connection or membrane inspection point.
functions: Provide direct access to concealed drainage
Allow reinstatement with correct supports and joints
materials: matching porcelain, concrete or stone paver

cad.pattern: One identified removable module over drain
cad.placement: Within raised paver field
cad.opening: Removal exposes drain-access opening
cad.load: Normal paver load when installed

objects.name: terrace planter drainage cell
objects.definition: A rigid, void-forming layer inside a waterproof terrace planter that carries excess irrigation and rainwater toward an outlet while keeping most growing medium away from the membrane and outlet path.
functions: Maintain a drainage path below growing medium
Reduce prolonged water pressure against protected membrane
Convey water to the planter outlet

cad.pattern: Continuous modular drainage layer with cut-outs at outlets
cad.placement: Over protected planter membrane and below filter layer
cad.opening: Cut and detailed around outlets and penetrations
cad.load: Growing-medium load distributed to planter shell

notes: A drainage cell drains water; it is not automatically a root barrier or membrane protection layer.

objects.name: external membrane drainage mat
objects.definition: A sheet or composite layer with an internal drainage path installed above a protected external membrane beneath a compatible finish, ballast or planter build-up.
functions: Separate overlying materials from the membrane
Provide protection or pressure relief only where the selected product is rated for it

cad.pattern: Continuous sheet following membrane falls
cad.placement: Above protected membrane and below the selected finish build-up
cad.opening: Detailed around supports, outlets and penetrations
cad.load: Overburden transferred through rated composite

notes: Do not assume every drainage mat is suitable below pedestals or heavy planters.

objects.name: terrace planter filter geotextile
objects.definition: A water-permeable filter fabric separating planter growing medium from the drainage layer so fine particles are less likely to clog drainage voids and outlets.
functions: Allow water to reach the drainage layer
Wrap or separate drainage components as detailed

cad.pattern: Continuous fabric above and around drainage layer
cad.placement: Between drainage layer and growing medium
cad.opening: Kept clear of the designed outlet entry
cad.load: Filter separation, not structural support

objects.name: terrace planter root barrier
objects.definition: A root-resistant sheet, coating or separately documented membrane layer that limits plant-root penetration into vulnerable waterproofing and junctions.
functions: Protect the waterproofing system from selected planting
Continue around planter corners and penetrations

cad.pattern: Continuous lining to root-exposed planter faces
cad.placement: On or above the protected waterproofing as documented
cad.opening: Sealed or formed around outlets and penetrations
cad.load: Root-resistance layer only

notes: Root resistance must be a documented product property; the word waterproof does not prove it.

objects.name: terrace planter structural shell
objects.definition: The loadbearing or self-supporting base and walls that contain a built-in terrace planter and provide the substrate or backing for its waterproofing build-up.
functions: Contain growing medium and water loads
Transfer planter actions to the platform structure

cad.pattern: Contained base with perimeter walls
cad.placement: On or integral with the terrace structure
cad.opening: Formed openings for drainage, overflow and services
cad.load: Wet growing medium, vegetation, retained water and maintenance actions

notes: Planting loads and retained water are structural inputs; they are not inferred from planter dimensions alone.

objects.name: terrace planter drainage outlet
objects.definition: A membrane-compatible outlet at the planter drainage layer that discharges excess water without allowing growing medium or roots to obstruct the primary flow path.
functions: Connect the waterproof lining to the drainage system
Remain accessible or protected against blockage

cad.pattern: One or more outlets at planter low points
cad.placement: At the waterproofed base or side-wall low point
cad.opening: Strained entry remains clear
cad.load: Water flow, not planter support

objects.name: terrace planter overflow outlet
objects.definition: A secondary opening or pipe at a nominated higher level that visibly or safely discharges water if the planter primary drain is restricted or inflow exceeds its working capacity.
functions: Indicate a blocked or overwhelmed primary outlet where visible

cad.pattern: Secondary opening above primary drainage level
cad.placement: Through planter wall or as standpipe
cad.opening: Screened without blocking design flow
cad.load: Overflow water only

notes: A planter overflow does not substitute for a primary drain.

objects.name: under-deck drainage tray
objects.definition: A formed trough or pan below open-jointed decking that catches water passing through board gaps and conveys it on a fall to an edge gutter or outlet.
functions: Keep the selected area below drier
Convey captured water to controlled drainage

cad.pattern: Repeated or continuous falling trays beneath deck-board joints
cad.placement: Below open-jointed decking and above the protected area
cad.opening: Cut and sealed around posts and services
cad.load: Captured runoff and maintenance actions only

notes: An under-deck tray is a separate secondary water-management system; board gaps above remain open.

objects.name: under-deck drainage wall flashing
objects.definition: A wall-side flashing that turns captured water from an under-deck tray system away from the building envelope and into the tray field without blocking wall drainage paths.
functions: Close the high edge of the tray system
Coordinate with cladding cavity and deck ledger interfaces

cad.pattern: Continuous flashing along tray high edge
cad.placement: At building wall above the under-deck tray field
cad.end: Opposite side edge with end treatment
cad.opening: Detailed around posts and wall penetrations
cad.load: Water shedding only

notes: The wall-cladding cavity must retain its intended drainage and ventilation paths.

objects.name: under-deck drainage outlet fitting
objects.definition: A formed fitting connecting an under-deck tray or local sump to an edge gutter, rainhead or drainage pipe.
functions: Provide a sealed transition to downstream drainage
Allow inspection or cleaning where required

cad.pattern: At each documented tray collection point
cad.placement: At low point or edge of under-deck tray field
cad.opening: Open flow path with accessible entry
cad.load: Runoff flow only

objects.name: under-deck drainage tray support
objects.definition: A clip, rail, batten or bracket that holds an under-deck tray at its designed profile and fall without relying on the visible soffit lining as drainage support.
functions: Set tray fall and joint alignment
Keep tray loads separate from unsupported lining

cad.pattern: Repeated supports following tray layout
cad.placement: Below deck framing or at tray edges
cad.opening: Trimmed around services and posts
cad.load: Tray self-weight, captured water and maintenance disturbance

objects.name: exterior balcony or terrace tile
objects.definition: A ceramic, porcelain or suitable natural-stone unit selected for a bonded, weather-exposed trafficable finish over an exterior balcony or terrace build-up.
functions: Shed surface water along designed falls
Resist weather, traffic and cleaning actions for the selected use
attributes: weather and freeze-thaw suitability where relevant

cad.pattern: Repeated jointed units following set-out and falls
cad.placement: Bonded to compatible prepared bed or substrate above waterproofing
cad.opening: Cut around drains, posts and penetrations without blocking drainage
cad.load: Pedestrian traffic through adhesive and bed to substrate

notes: A tiled finish is not the waterproofing layer and must not be modelled as one.

objects.name: exterior ceramic balcony tile
objects.definition: A ceramic tile product documented as suitable for the selected external, trafficable and climatic exposure.
functions: Follow the tiled surface set-out and falls
Transfer traffic through the bonded build-up

cad.pattern: Repeated ceramic units
cad.placement: In exterior tile adhesive bed
cad.opening: Cut around drainage and penetrations
cad.load: Traffic through bonded bed

notes: The material name alone does not establish external suitability or slip performance.

objects.name: exterior porcelain balcony tile
objects.definition: A porcelain tile unit selected and installed as a bonded weather-exposed balcony or terrace finish.
functions: Provide a dense exterior tile finish
Transfer traffic through the bonded build-up
materials: surface finish or glaze where supplied

cad.pattern: Repeated porcelain units
cad.placement: In exterior tile adhesive bed
cad.opening: Cut around drainage and penetrations
cad.load: Traffic through bonded bed

notes: A thinner bonded porcelain tile and a structurally rated pedestal paver are different objects even when their exposed faces look alike.

objects.name: exterior natural-stone balcony tile
objects.definition: A dimensioned natural-stone unit selected for bonded installation in the particular exterior exposure and supported by a compatible bed, adhesive, joint and waterproofing build-up.
functions: Transfer traffic through the bonded build-up

cad.pattern: Repeated natural-stone units
cad.placement: In documented exterior stone adhesive or mortar build-up
cad.opening: Cut and edge-finished at outlets and penetrations
cad.load: Traffic through bonded bed

notes: Stone selection must account for weathering, moisture movement, staining and the chosen installation system.

objects.name: exterior balcony tile adhesive bed
objects.definition: The compatible cementitious, reaction-resin or other documented adhesive layer bonding exterior trafficable tiles to the prepared screed, mortar bed or system substrate.
functions: Bond tiles to the prepared backing
Accommodate documented conditions within the selected adhesive classification

cad.pattern: Continuous thin bed beneath each tile with explicit perimeter and movement breaks
cad.placement: Between prepared bed or substrate and exterior tile
cad.opening: Stops cleanly at movement joints, drains and penetrations
cad.load: Bond and shear transfer

notes: Adhesive selection cannot be inferred from tile material alone.

objects.name: exterior balcony tile grout
objects.definition: The joint-filling material between exterior balcony tiles, excluding the flexible sealant and movement-joint locations that must remain able to move.
functions: Permit cleaning and surface drainage without claiming waterproofing

cad.pattern: Repeated filled joints between tiles
cad.placement: Between exterior tile edges
cad.opening: Excluded from flexible and drainage openings
cad.load: Joint filling, not structural support

notes: Grout is not treated as the waterproof layer.

objects.name: exterior balcony flexible tile sealant joint
objects.definition: A movement-capable sealed joint through the exterior tile finish at a perimeter, junction, control location or movement joint, using compatible backing and sealant.
functions: Carry substrate and membrane joint strategy through the finish where required

cad.pattern: Continuous selected joints through tile field and perimeters
cad.placement: Between tile edges above coordinated substrate and membrane detail
cad.opening: Uninterrupted except at designed intersections
cad.load: Movement and weather seal only

notes: A finish sealant joint and the membrane movement detail are related but remain separate model objects.

objects.name: exterior balcony tile movement-joint profile
objects.definition: A proprietary profile with rigid edge legs and a movement-capable centre installed through the exterior tile finish at a selected movement-joint route.
functions: Accommodate documented movement at the finish plane

cad.pattern: Linear profile along selected joint route
cad.placement: Flush with exterior tile surface
cad.opening: Continuous movement zone through tile finish
cad.load: Edge protection and finish-level movement

objects.name: exterior balcony tile edge trim
objects.definition: A corrosion-suitable finishing profile protecting an exposed exterior tile edge at a step, free edge, skirting termination, drain or transition without replacing the required waterproof edge detail.
functions: Protect and finish exposed tile edges
Coordinate with drip, drainage and membrane terminations

cad.pattern: Continuous edge profile with formed corners and joins
cad.placement: At exposed exterior tile edge or termination
cad.opening: Stops or forms around drains and penetrations
cad.load: Tile-edge protection only

notes: A decorative trim does not prove that the membrane edge is weatherproof.

objects.name: low-deck drainage aggregate layer
objects.definition: A prepared free-draining mineral layer beneath a close-to-ground deck used to reduce ponding and muddy surface conditions while preserving the required falls, clearance, ventilation and termite visibility strategy.
functions: Provide a drained ground surface below the deck
Reduce splash and persistent surface wetting
Keep the under-deck area distinct from structural supports and termite inspection paths

cad.pattern: Continuous prepared layer beneath low deck with local clear zones
cad.placement: On graded ground below deck framing
cad.end: Free-draining edge or documented collection point
cad.opening: Kept clear around inspection zones, posts, footings and drains
cad.load: Ground surfacing only, not assumed to support deck structure

notes: Aggregate alone does not solve restricted drying, poor ventilation or termite-concealment risks.

objects.name: deck-to-building termite inspection zone
objects.definition: A deliberately visible and accessible clearance or inspection route at a deck-to-building, post, pier or perimeter interface so concealed termite entry is not created by the deck construction.
functions: Separate deck finishes or framing from nominated termite barriers
Expose relevant entry paths for maintenance

cad.pattern: Continuous or nominated clear inspection route
cad.placement: At relevant deck-to-building, perimeter, post or pier interfaces
cad.opening: Must remain visible and accessible rather than filled
cad.load: No load; reserved inspection space

notes: The required form and dimensions are project- and system-specific; do not encode one universal gap.

objects.name: balcony structural floor setdown
objects.definition: A deliberately lower structural floor zone at a waterproof balcony or terrace that provides vertical depth for falls, membrane, drainage and finishes below the adjoining internal floor or protected threshold level.
functions: Create depth for the exterior build-up
Support drainage falls and threshold weathering
Coordinate structure with door, wall and waterproofing interfaces
materials: edge beam or upstand where designed

cad.pattern: Lowered structural field bounded by step, beam, wall or edge
cad.placement: Below waterproof balcony build-up adjoining higher protected construction
cad.opening: Coordinates drain bodies, services and door openings
cad.load: Structural platform loads as designed

notes: A setdown is structural geometry, not the same object as a screed fall or membrane upturn.

objects.name: balcony underside soffit enclosure assembly
objects.definition: An exterior lining, support and trim build-up enclosing the underside of a balcony or elevated deck, coordinated with drainage, structure, movement, services, ventilation and inspection access.
functions: Protect selected services or secondary drainage without concealing required inspection
Coordinate lining support with balcony edges and walls
attributes: fire and acoustic requirements where applicable

cad.pattern: Jointed lining field below balcony structure
cad.placement: On exterior soffit support framing beneath balcony or deck
cad.opening: Trimmed around lights, drains, services and access panels
cad.load: Lining self-weight and external pressure actions, not balcony traffic

notes: A closed soffit must not hide drainage leaks or structural and termite inspection points without planned access.

objects.name: terrace perimeter parapet or waterproofing hob assembly
objects.definition: A raised perimeter wall, kerb or hob at a waterproof terrace comprising its structure, membrane upturn, termination, capping or flashing, movement joints and any primary or overflow openings.
functions: Support and protect the membrane perimeter termination
Coordinate capping, drainage openings and barrier or wall construction

cad.pattern: Continuous raised perimeter with joint and outlet interruptions
cad.placement: At contained edge of waterproof terrace
cad.opening: Formed and membrane-flanged at scuppers and overflows
cad.load: Structural, barrier or weathering loads only as separately designed

notes: Parapet, waterproofing hob and safety barrier are separate roles even when one physical assembly performs more than one.
